shape.text: A PEM-encoded private key uses the textual encoding of RFC 7468: a line beginning -----BEGIN followed by a label, base64 body lines, and a matching -----END line with the same label. The BEGIN and END lines belong to the secret.
Service-account key files in JSON embed the PEM as a string with literal backslash-n escapes in place of line breaks.
